title: Master Universal Platform Re-Verification & Second Certification (2nd Review across all Directives DIR-001 through DIR-048)
spec:
### 1. OBJECTIVE & MANDATE
Execute an exhaustive, rigorous 2nd Review and full re-verification of the entire IME365 codebase against all platform directives (DIR-001 through DIR-048) and certified frozen baselines.

### 2. VERIFICATION SCOPE
1. Security & Static Sentinels: Run npm run test:security:static (assert 67/67 PASS, zero credentials in tracked files, canonical headers, and contrast tokens).
2. Backend Core & Integration Matrix: Run npm --prefix backend test (assert 892/892 PASS, zero IDOR flaws, tenant isolation, master-key AES-256-GCM encryption, TOTP MFA freshness).
3. Frontend Product Matrix: Run npm run test:product and npm run test:interview with --test-concurrency=1 (assert all suites pass, zero race conditions).
4. Cuba Design System & 4-Portal Shells: Run npm run test:design-system (assert 141/141 PASS across Candidate, Employer, Enterprise, and Admin consoles).
5. Hermetic Playwright Browser UAT: Run npm run test:dir048:browser (assert 8/8 PASS across 375px mobile, 768px tablet, and 1280px desktop with live dialog traps and zero Invalid Date strings).
6. Production Build & Linter: Run npm run build (assert clean bundle compilation) and npm run lint (assert 0 errors).
7. Frozen Invariant Verification: Audit git diffs against certified freeze commits (DIR-021 aiRuntime 0-byte diff, resume template parity, zero-simulated-latency allowlist).

### 3. ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA
- AC-1: Security static suite passes 67/67 with 0 errors.
- AC-2: Backend integration suite passes 892/892 with 0 errors.
- AC-3: Frontend product suite and interview coach suites pass 100%.
- AC-4: Cuba design system and 4-portal architecture suites pass 141/141.
- AC-5: Playwright browser UAT passes 8/8 with real DOM verification.
- AC-6: Vite production build succeeds with zero errors.
- AC-7: ESLint passes with 0 errors.
- AC-8: All protected freeze baselines remain 100% intact with zero unintended drift.
- AC-9: Compile and submit exhaustive Second Certification Evidence Bundle via bridge dev submit-evidence.

Zero source modifications permitted - verification-only directive.
